# ResuMoose

> AI-powered resume builder that helps job seekers create professional, ATS-optimized resumes.

## What is ResuMoose?

ResuMoose is a resume building platform where users enter their career history once, then generate tailored resumes for specific job opportunities. The AI analyzes job postings, identifies key requirements, and creates targeted resumes highlighting the most relevant experience.

## Primary URL

https://resumoose.com

## Core Value Proposition

Resume writing is a translation exercise - translating your experience into language hiring managers and ATS systems expect. Most people undersell themselves or struggle to articulate their value. ResuMoose solves this by:

1. Storing your complete career history in one place
2. Analyzing job postings you're interested in
3. Generating tailored resumes that match your experience to requirements
4. Letting you review and control the final output

## Key Features

- AI-powered resume generation from career history
- ATS (Applicant Tracking System) optimization
- Job-specific resume tailoring based on job posting analysis
- Federal resume support for USAJOBS applications
- Real-time preview and editing
- PDF export
- User maintains full control - AI suggests, user decides

## Best For

- People who find resume writing painful or anxiety-inducing
- Job seekers applying to multiple positions who need tailored resumes
- Career changers needing help translating transferable skills
- Anyone struggling to articulate their accomplishments professionally
- Federal job applicants needing properly formatted resumes

## Not Ideal For

- Entry-level candidates with no work history
- People who just need a simple template
- Those wanting 100% AI-generated content with no review

## How It Works

1. Build career profile (one-time): Enter work history, skills, education, accomplishments
2. Paste job posting: When applying, paste the job description
3. AI analysis: ResuMoose matches your experience to job requirements
4. Generate resume: Creates tailored draft highlighting relevant experience
5. Review and edit: User has full control to adjust
6. Export PDF: Download ATS-optimized resume

## Pricing

Token-based model (not subscription) because resume building is "burst use" - needed intensely during job searches, not continuously. Free tier available.
